Owned Clubs}} '''Girona Futbol Club, [[Sociedad Anónima Deportiva|S.A.D.]]''' ({{IPA|ca|ʒiˈɾonə|lang|Pronunciation of Girona in Catalan.ogg}} {{respell|zhi|RO|nuh}}) is a Spanish professional [[Football team|football club]] based in [[Girona]], [[Catalonia]], [[Spain]]. Founded on 23 July 1930, the team plays in the [[Segunda División]], following relegation from the [[2025–26 La Liga]] season. Girona holds its home matches at the 14,624-capacity [[Estadi Montilivi]]. It is a part of [[City Football Group|City Football Group Limited]]. The club also has youth and amateur women's teams for competition. [[File:Estadio montilivi 02-12-2018.jpg|thumb|right|300px|Girona FC home stadium Estadi Montilivi.]]"}}
